description: SHANGHAI (AP) — Choi Hye-jin overcame difficult scoring conditions Friday to shoot a 2-over 74 but still maintained a two-stroke lead after two rounds of the LPGA Shanghai tournament. Choi, seeking her first win on the LPGA Tour to add to her 12 victories in her native South Korea, had a two-round total of 6-under 138. Choi led by three strokes after the first round. “Actually, my body is not in perfect condition but I am still on the lead,” Choi said. "I’m really looking forward on the weekend.
title: A tough day on the golf course: Choi maintains lead after two rounds of LPGA Shanghai
